title:
A VOICE Hold that fellow with the bad breeches.
 
 BEN DOLLARD (Smites his thigh in abundant laughter.) Hold him now.
html_source:
Echoes the conversation between Simon and Ben in The Wandering Rocks, already echoed in the counterpoint of Sirens. The fact that neither Bloom nor Stephen were present when these words were uttered previously problematises the usual interpretation of the hallucinations as Stephen and Bloom’s subjective experiences.

Perhaps the words only represent a familiar banter between Simon and Benn.
